core_categories: Medical-Surgical Distribution; Surgical and Medical Instruments; Orthopedic Devices; Hospital Equipment and Furniture; Consumables and Care Supplies; Biologics and Dental Biologics
specialty_focus: Buffalo Hospital Supply is a medical-surgical distributor that connects healthcare device manufacturers with hospitals, nursing homes, and federal healthcare systems like the Department of Defense (DoD) and Veterans Affairs (VA) facilities. Its specialty focus includes government and federal contracting, managing procurement vehicles like FSS, DAPA, and ECAT under Federal Acquisition Regulations (FARs), and serving as a channel partner for veteran and military healthcare. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
